description: This file defines the 'ReferencedObjectCollection' class used for tracking object references during serialization, deserialization, or copying in the Orleans.Serialization.Session namespace. It manages references and IDs, handles overflow scenarios, and provides methods for referencing, copying, and resetting reference data.

classes.name: ReferencedObjectCollection
classes.description: A collection class managing object references during serialization processes, including reference creation, lookup, overflow handling, and reset functionality.

methods.name: TryGetReferencedObject
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a referenced object by its ID.

methods.name: MarkValueField
methods.description: Marks a value field by incrementing the current reference ID.

methods.name: CreateRecordPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new placeholder ID for a record.

methods.name: GetOrAddReference
methods.description: Retrieves an existing reference for a value or adds a new one, returning whether the reference already existed.

methods.name: GetReferenceIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the reference for a given object or -1 if not found.

methods.name: RecordReferenceField
methods.description: Records a reference field with an automatically incremented reference ID.

methods.name: RecordReferenceField
methods.description: Records a reference field with a specified reference ID.

methods.name: CopyReferenceTable
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current reference ID-to-object mapping.

methods.name: CopyIdTable
methods.description: Creates a copy of the object-to-reference ID mapping.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal state and clears stored references and mappings.
